what: Home Depot is the largest home-improvement retailer in the US, selling tools, building materials and garden products to homeowners and professional contractors.
customers: Do-it-yourself homeowners and professional builders, roofers and contractors (a growing share after the SRS acquisition).
money: SRS and GMS supply to contractors
moat: Scale, store locations, supplier relationships and loyal professional customers.
risks: A slow housing market and high mortgage rates
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 22%, exceptional for a retailer
Its professional contractor business grows faster than consumer sales
A dividend yield near 3% with a long record of increases
watch: Comparable sales and professional customer transaction growth.
